arxiv-2109-09122.title: Geometry-induced Monopole Magnetic Field and Quantum Spin Hall Effect
arxiv-2109-09122.creator: Yong-Long Wang 1,2, Hao Zhao 1,2, Hua Jiang 1, Hui Liu 2, Yan-Feng Chen 3
arxiv-2109-09122.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Yong-Long Wang 1,2, Hao Zhao 1,2, Hua Jiang 1, Hui Liu 2, Yan-Feng Chen 3. The geometric effects of two-dimensional curved systems have been an interesting topic for a long time. A Möbius surface is specifically considered.

arxiv-2309-10449.title: Parabolic Fontaine-Faltings modules and parabolic Higgs-de Rham flows
arxiv-2309-10449.creator: Zhenmou Liu, Jinbang Yang, Kang Zuo
arxiv-2309-10449.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Zhenmou Liu, Jinbang Yang, Kang Zuo. In this note, we aim to extend the concepts of the Fontaine-Faltings module and Higgs-de Rham flow to parabolic versions. The crucial aspect of our generalization lies in the construction of parabolic inverse Cartier functors. The twisted versions discussed in Sun-Yang-Zuo’s work can be viewed as a special case, wherein the parabolic weights are equal at every infinity point.

arxiv-2310-20347.title: Algorithm XXX: Automatic Generators for a Family of Matrix Multiplication Routines with Apache TVM CCS: Mathematics of computing Mathematical software performance CCS: Computing methodologies Vector / streaming algorithms CCS: Software and its engineering Software development techniques
arxiv-2310-20347.creator: Guillermo Alaejos, Adrián Castelló, Pedro Alonso-Jordá, Francisco D. Igual, Héctor Martínez, Enrique S. Quintana-Ortí
arxiv-2310-20347.description: Abstract . We explore the utilization of the Apache TVM open source framework to automatically generate a family of algorithms that follow the approach taken by popular linear algebra libraries, such as GotoBLAS2, BLIS and OpenBLAS, in order to obtain high-performance blocked formulations of the general matrix multiplication ( gemm ).

arxiv-2312-03171.title: Combining Counting Processes and Classification Improves a Stopping Rule for Technology Assisted Review
arxiv-2312-03171.creator: Reem Bin-Hezam, Mark Stevenson
arxiv-2312-03171.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Reem Bin-Hezam, Mark Stevenson. Technology Assisted Review (TAR) stopping rules aim to reduce the cost of manually assessing documents for relevance by minimising the number of documents that need to be examined to ensure a desired level of recall. This paper extends an effective stopping rule using information derived from a text classifier that can be trained without the need for any additional annotation.

arxiv-2401-15272.title: Population Level Activity in Large Random Neural Networks
arxiv-2401-15272.creator: James MacLaurin, Moshe Silverstein, Pedro Vilanova
arxiv-2401-15272.description: Abstract We determine limiting equations for large asymmetric ‘spin glass’ networks. The initial conditions are not assumed to be independent of the disordered connectivity: one of the main motivations for this is that allows one to understand how the structure of the limiting equations depends on the energy landscape of the random connectivity.

arxiv-2403-17485.title: From Computing to Quantum Mechanics: Accessible and Hands-On Quantum Computing Education for High School Students
arxiv-2403-17485.creator: Qihong Sun, Shuangxiang Zhou, Ronghang Chen, Guanru Feng, Shi-Yao Hou, Bei Zeng
arxiv-2403-17485.description: Abstract This paper outlines an alternative approach to teaching quantum computing at the high school level, tailored for students with limited prior knowledge in advanced mathematics and physics. This approach diverges from traditional methods by building upon foundational concepts in classical computing before gradually introducing quantum mechanics, thereby simplifying the entry into this complex field.

arxiv-2405-17700.title: Learning Social Welfare Functions
arxiv-2405-17700.creator: Kanad Shrikar Pardeshi, Itai Shapira, Ariel D. Procaccia, Aarti Singh
arxiv-2405-17700.description: Abstract Is it possible to understand or imitate a policy maker’s rationale by looking at past decisions they made? We formalize this question as the problem of learning social welfare functions belonging to the well-studied family of power mean functions.

arxiv-2503-24103.title: Constructing Chayet–Garibaldi algebras from affine vertex algebras (including the 3876 3876 -dimensional algebra for E 8 E_{8} )
arxiv-2503-24103.creator: Tom De Medts, Louis Olyslager
arxiv-2503-24103.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Tom De Medts, Louis Olyslager. In 2021, Maurice Chayet and Skip Garibaldi provided an explicit construction of a commutative non-associative algebra on the second smallest representation of E 8 E_{8} (of dimension 3875 3875 ) adjoined with a unit. In fact, they define such an algebra A ⁡ ( 𝔤 ) A(\mathfrak{g}) for each simple Lie algebra 𝔤 \mathfrak{g} , in terms of explicit but ad-hoc formulas.

arxiv-2504-07136.title: The spectrum of magnetized turbulence in the interstellar medium
arxiv-2504-07136.creator: James R. Beattie, Christoph Federrath, Ralf S. Klessen, Salvatore Cielo, Amitava Bhattacharjee
arxiv-2504-07136.description: Abstract The interstellar medium (ISM) of our Galaxy is magnetized, compressible and turbulent, influencing many key ISM properties, like star formation, cosmic ray transport, and metal and phase mixing. Yet, basic statistics describing compressible, magnetized turbulence remain uncertain. Utilizing grid resolutions up to 10,080 3 10,\!

arxiv-2511-17621.title: From Competition to Coordination: Market Making as a Scalable Framework for Safe and Aligned Multi-Agent LLM Systems
arxiv-2511-17621.creator: Brendan Gho, Suman Muppavarapu, Afnan Shaik, James Begin, Kevin Zhu
arxiv-2511-17621.description: Abstract As foundation models are increasingly deployed as interacting agents in multi-agent systems, their collective behavior raises new challenges for trustworthiness, transparency, and accountability. Traditional coordination mechanisms, such as centralized oversight or adversarial adjudication, struggle to scale and often obscure how decisions emerge.

arxiv-2512-09812.creator: Jan Moser
arxiv-2512-09812.description: Abstract . In our paper from 1985 we have constructed two integrals of the Riemann’s function Z 2 ​ ( t ) Z^{2}(t) over two disconnected sets with asymptotically equal measures such that these two integrals differ by considerably big excess.

arxiv-2512-11750.title: LUCID: Learning-Enabled Uncertainty-Aware Certification of Stochastic Dynamical Systems (Extended Version)
arxiv-2512-11750.creator: Ernesto Casablanca, Oliver Schön, Paolo Zuliani, Sadegh Soudjani
arxiv-2512-11750.description: Abstract Ensuring the safety of AI-enabled systems, particularly in high-stakes domains such as autonomous driving and healthcare, has become increasingly critical. Traditional formal verification tools fall short when faced with systems that embed both opaque, black-box AI components and complex stochastic dynamics.

pmc-11302310.title: Empowering mind-body wellness: effect of bundling seated exercises and psychoeducational rehabilitation using the teach-back approach on fatigue and coping of women postmastectomy
pmc-11302310.creator: Zohour Ibrahim Rashwan, Samah Ramadan Shaheen, Ayah Shaban Abd-El Fattah Abd-El Rasoul, Neama Mohamed Fouad Kamel, Hamida Ahmed Mostafa Darweesh
pmc-11302310.description: BackgroundBeing diagnosed with Breast Cancer (BC) is a crisis that throws the patient’s life out of balance. Cancer-related fatigue is a debilitating sign experienced by women during and after BC treatment. Regular physical exercise may help mitigate patients’ fatigue, enhance coping abilities, improve their quality of life, and overall well-being.

pmc-11310098.title: Peripheral hearing sensitivity is similar between the sexes in a benthic turtle species despite the larger body size of males
pmc-11310098.creator: Tongliang Wang, Jinxia Yang, Jinhong Lei, Jingdeng Huang, Haitao Shi, Jichao Wang
pmc-11310098.description: Sexually dimorphic hearing sensitivity has evolved in many vertebrate species, and the sex with a larger body size typically shows more sensitive hearing. However, generalizing this association is controversial. Research on sexually dimorphic hearing sensitivity contributes to an understanding of auditory sense functions, adaptations, and evolution among species.

pmc-11387065.title: Body size modulates the extent of seasonal diet switching by large mammalian herbivores in Yellowstone National Park
pmc-11387065.creator: Bethan L. Littleford-Colquhoun, Chris Geremia, Lauren M. McGarvey, Jerod A. Merkle, Hannah K. Hoff, Heidi Anderson, Carlisle R. Segal, Rebecca Y. Kartzinel, Ian J. Maywar, Natalie Nantais, Camela Moore, Tyler R. Kartzinel
pmc-11387065.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Prevailing theories about animal foraging behaviours and the food webs they occupy offer divergent predictions about whether seasonally limited food availability promotes dietary diversification or specialization. Emphasis on how animals compete for food predominates in work on the foraging ecology of large mammalian herbivores, whereas emphasis on how the diversity of available foods generally constrains dietary opportunity predominates work on entire food webs.

pmc-11438408.title: Dietary total antioxidant capacity and odds of lung cancer: a large case-control study
pmc-11438408.creator: Fatemeh Toorang, Monireh Sadat Seyyedsalehi, Bahareh Sasanfar, Hamideh Rashidian, Maryam Hadji, Mahin Gholipour, Maryam Marzban, Mahdieh Bakhshi, Abbas Rezaianzadeh, Paolo Boffetta, Kazem Zendehdel
pmc-11438408.description: HighlightsLung cancer (LC) is the most common cancer among males and the third most common cancer among females worldwide. Focusing on primary prevention may be the main strategy for reducing the overall mortality of LC, especially in LMICs.This study showed that dTAC assessed either by FRAP or TRAP procedure is inversely associated with the odds of LC.

pmc-11458961.title: The oxygen puzzle in FLASH radiotherapy: A comprehensive review and experimental outlook
pmc-11458961.creator: Andrea Scarmelotto, Victor Delprat, Carine Michiels, Stéphane Lucas, Anne-Catherine Heuskin
pmc-11458961.description: Highlights•Radiolytic oxygen depletion and DNA damage likely play a marginal role in inducing the FLASH effect.•Ultra-high dose rate may impact H2O2 production, but in vivo validation is required.•Cardiolipin and lipid are targets of oxidative stress during ultrahigh dose rate irradiation.•Techniques for in vivo experimental measurements of ROS are described.

pmc-11686641.title: Return to Sports and Sports Activities after Treatment of Osteochondral Lesions of the Ankle in Elite Athletes
pmc-11686641.creator: Jari Dahmen, Julian Hollander, Kishan Ramsodit, Quinten Rikken, Sjoerd Stufkens, Gino M MMJ Kerkhoffs
pmc-11686641.description: Category:AnkleIntroduction/Purpose:The aim of this study is to assess the return to sports rate and times after treatment of osteochondral lesions of the ankle in elite level athletes.Methods:All elite level athletes treated for an OLT(P) were selected from a cross-sectional database consisting of consecutive patients with cartilage injuries of the ankle and subsequently underwent prospective follow-up.

pmc-11892691.title: The First Sertoli Cell Tumor of the Adrenal Gland is Potentially Associated with Arterial Hypertension
pmc-11892691.creator: Sara Ivanis, Milan Marinkovic, Milan Jovanovic, Matija Buzejic, Marija Milinkovic, Zlatibor Loncar, Vladan Zivaljevic, Branislav Rovcanin
pmc-11892691.description: IntroductionSertoli cell tumors are rare sex cord-stromal tumors, accounting for less than 1% of primary testicular tumors. They typically arise in the testes and ovaries, with other localizations being uncommon. We present the case of a Sertoli cell tumor in the adrenal gland, which, to our knowledge, is the first reported in the literature.

pmc-13154551.title: Management and disposal of polythene bag waste among urban households in Lira City: a cross sectional survey
pmc-13154551.creator: Sam Orech, Cecilia Adyero, Charles Okolimong, Evaline Ajwang, Ruth Anne Akello
pmc-13154551.description: BackgroundImproper disposal of waste has implications for public health worldwide. This issue is not limited to use polythene bags alone.
